summary: {resident} can see a pardoned case at the courthouse after it disappears from the public website.
realLife: Maryland explained that its 2026 change removed pardoned possession cases from online Case Search while courthouse kiosks still displayed them.
gates: Effective public-access rule and separate online and onsite views.
inGame: needs: effective public-access rule and separate online and onsite views.

turns.pulledBy: The resident asks why the web search is blank.
turns.writesBack: The response identifies where a notation can still be checked.
